text:
infra-bot: ALERT: Staging rollout release/2026-03-17 - 5xx rate stepped to 6.8% (threshold 5%) across canary slice; 3/5 health checks failing. Automated guardrail triggered. https://internal.monitoring/redwood/staging

sarah_oncall: ack. paging tom and mike. I'm at my desk, pulling logs.

tom_pager: on pager, joining. any obvious error?

mike_sre: looking at proxy logs — I see repetitive `kvcache: eviction error: OOM` around the same times as 5xx spikes. past few deploys had quantized model footprint increase.

jess_prod: Rolling back flag ready? We have a feature flag toggle to cut canary entirely if needed: ff.rollout_v2_canary = false

sarah_oncall: run the rollback guardrail first: disable canary slice traffic -> then rollback image if still unhealthy. mike, can you try disabling canary routing?

mike_sre: running command now: `./infractl traffic set-slice --env=staging --slice=canary --pct=0`

ops-bot: CMD OK: traffic-slice canary set to 0% (actor=mike_sre).

infra-bot: Guardrail action: traffic diverted from canary -> baseline. 5xx rate reduced to 1.2% within 45s. Continuing to observe.

tom_pager: good signal. still see some 502s from a subset of nodes (edge-proxy). pulling pod logs:```2026-03-17T09:42:11Z proxy error: upstream write failed: broken pipe
kvcache: Evicted 12345 entries, alloc 98%```

sarah_oncall: temporary mitigation = keep canary at 0%. decide on rollback of image tag next. jess, do we want full rollback to prior model build or just a canary image revert?

jess_prod: revert canary image to v2026-03-10 build first, since quantization changes landed in 03-16 build. prepare rollback patch: `image: registry.redwood/model-serving:v2026-03-10`

mike_sre: applied canary image revert to v2026-03-10 and restarted canary pods. monitoring. ops-bot shows pod restarts healthy.

infra-bot: Post-action metrics: canary 5xx -> 0.4%, overall latency stable. Health checks passing across all nodes.

tom_pager: looks green. I'll stand down pager in 15m unless any regressions.

sarah_oncall: creating incident note and impact assessment. customer impact: minimal — no user-facing outages in production; staging only rollout. No follow-up owner required for customer comms.

jess_prod: open follow-up task: investigate quantization change regression and add memory guard to canary config. assign to mike_sre.

mike_sre: acknowledged, will triage tree, add guard and smaller mem target for next canary.

sarah_oncall: handing off to oncall-next (tom_pager will watch for 30m). Handoff at 10:05 UTC. Please escalate if 5xx rises >1% again. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident closed (auto) — guardrail succeeded, root cause suspected model quantization memory spike. Reference: https://internal.postmortem/INC-1715009999
